## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 31 captures during August 2024. The activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational issues noted in the supplied report.

The captured images were submitted for review through the usual process. Activity levels and the available session arrangements supported continued delivery at the clinic throughout the month.

## Image quality

Image quality review found 3 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 9.7. These images could not be assessed reliably for grading purposes. The result should be considered alongside the total capture activity for the month and used to support routine monitoring of image quality and capture practice.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. These outcomes were recorded for appropriate follow-up through the established pathway. The median lag between capture and grading was 2, indicating that reviewed images generally progressed through the service within a short interval. The findings provide a summary of grading activity and turnaround at Harbour Eye Clinic for August 2024.
